Normed alternating precomposition.description: For a nontrivially normed field K, normed K-spaces E,E',F and a finite index type ι, define Q(f)(m)(x)=m(f∘x). Here f:E→L[K]E', m:E'[⋀^ι]→L[K]F and Q(f):(E'[⋀^ι]→L[K]F)→L[K](E[⋀^ι]→L[K]F). Alternating means vanishing whenever two coordinates agree. These are normed spaces; a complete target makes the relevant map spaces complete.
Normed alternating precomposition.mathlib_notes: Exact declarations inspected. This is the object Q, not the analytic classification.

Algebraic exterior power infrastructure.description: For every field L, L-vector space V and degree k, the exterior power Λ^k_L V represents alternating k-linear maps. It is spanned by pure wedges; a basis of V induces the increasing-subset wedge basis. Linear maps act functorially on exterior powers, and an injection of vector spaces induces an injection of exterior powers.
Algebraic exterior power infrastructure.mathlib_notes: Exact basis and universal-property declarations inspected. Existing local AlternatingAnalytic.toTensorPower_injective in AlternatingAnalytic/Algebra/ExteriorSupport.lean is useful verified infrastructure but does not prove support dimension or determinant-array injectivity. Exact exteriorPower.map_injective_field inspected at Basic.lean:321.

Finite-dimensional continuity and comple.description: Over a complete nontrivially normed field, a finite-dimensional normed space is complete and every linear map from it to a normed space is continuous. A linear map defined on a dense normed subspace with bound ‖Tx‖≤C‖x‖ extends uniquely to a Banach target with the same bound. A k-linear map on products of dense subspaces with bound C∏‖x_i‖ extends uniquely to the completed spaces with the same bound.
Finite-dimensional continuity and comple.mathlib_notes: Full heterogeneous finite-family extension proved: arbitrary independent dense linear isometries, agreement, uniqueness, exact norm preservation, and raw multilinear bound preservation. Only target completeness is assumed for extension, neither base/source completeness nor ultrametricity. Zero arity included. Raw C-bound statement explicitly assumes C≥0, as required for a norm-bound constant in degenerate zero spaces. Independent dense-multilinear-extension-independent and dense-family-independent gates verified all 14+20 owned declarations, unchanged files, standard axioms only. Finite-dimensional facts are established Mathlib declarations.

Exterior support dimension.description: For k≥1 and ω∈Λ^k_L V, define sdim(ω) as the least finite dimension of an L-subspace W of V for which ω belongs to the image of Λ^kW. Every ω has such a W. One has sdim(0)=0, sdim(cω)=sdim(ω) for c≠0, sdim(ω+η)≤sdim(ω)+sdim(η), and sdim(ω)≤dim span S whenever ω is a sum of wedges using a finite set S. An injective ambient-space enlargement cannot increase support dimension.

Analyticity at a point is equivalent to.id: Analyticity at a point is equivalent to a bounded lift
Analyticity at a point is equivalent to.description: For k≥1, Q has a bounded k-linear lift P with P(f,…,f)=Q(f) if and only if Q is analytic at some point, if and only if it is analytic at every point. A lift gives a finite power series with infinite radius at every point. For every analytic expansion at f₀, its degree-k coefficient is a lift. If no lift exists then ContDiffAt K ω Q f₀ fails at every f₀. No completeness or characteristic assumption is added.

Vector-valued polynomial identity princi.description: Let L be an infinite field and Y an L-vector space. If a polynomial g(λ)=∑_α λ^α y_α with finitely many coefficients vanishes for every λ∈L^m, then y_α=0 for every α.

Multiplier lifts and polarized identitie.description: For a field L, vector spaces A,V and a linear family D:A→End_L(V), a degree-k lift is a map Ψ:A^k×V^k→Λ^kV multilinear in all 2k slots and alternating in the V slots. Pw is Ψ(a,…,a;x)=D_a x₁∧⋯∧D_a x_k. Pol equates the coefficient sums over functions f:[k]→[m] of each fixed multiplicity type α in the expansion at ∑λ_i b_i. Pol1 is ∑_{σ∈S_k}Ψ(b_σ;x)=∑_{σ∈S_k}D_{b_{σ(1)}}x₁∧⋯∧D_{b_{σ(k)}}x_k. Over every field Pol⇒Pw⇒Pol1; over an infinite field Pw⇒Pol.
depends_on: Cardinality of a finite symmetric group

Cluster coefficients and order-pattern v.description: Let V=L^ℕ, Vfin=L^(ℕ), and let Ψ:Vfin^k×Vfin^k→Λ^kV satisfy the multiplier obstruction hypotheses. Put T(a;y;c)=Ω(Ψ(e_a;e_y))(c). On an infinite set H homogeneous for its 3k-coordinate patterns, a cluster is four consecutive elements C(0)<⋯<C(3) of H. Define s_C=∑s_i e_{C(i)} and w_C=∑w_i e_{C(i)}. For pairwise disjoint clusters C₁,…,C_k, put χ(C)=Ω(Ψ(s_{C₁},…,s_{C_k};w_{C₁},…,w_{C_k}))(C₁(0),…,C_k(0)). This depends only on the permutation τ giving the order of the labeled clusters.

Valued Laurent series and their complete.id: Valued Laurent series and their completeness
Valued Laurent series and their complete.description: For every field κ, the Laurent series κ((X)) form a complete discretely valued field, with value group Z and monomial valuation determined by its integer exponent. The coefficient functions are additive and κ-linear; series have supports bounded below.
Valued Laurent series and their complete.mathlib_notes: Exact declarations inspected. They do not by themselves install the real norm with an arbitrary prescribed r; that is the next node.

Laurent norms and bounded-sequence coeff.description: For κ a field and 0<r<1, give K₁=κ((X)) the norm ‖a‖=r^ord(a) for a≠0. This makes it a complete nontrivially normed ultrametric field. Put E₁=ℓ∞(ℕ,K₁) and E₀=κ^ℕ embedded as constant Laurent sequences. E₁ is Banach and ultrametric; nonzero elements of E₀ have norm 1. For nonzero x∈E₁ there is an attained least coordinate order ν(x) with ‖x‖=r^ν(x), and its coefficient sequences x_[n] vanish for n<ν(x). Coefficient zero is κ-linear and vanishes on bounded arrays of sup norm <1. Finally M_r=max_{l∈ℕ}(l+1)r^l exists and is positive; for r≤1/2 it equals 1.
depends_on: Valued Laurent series and their completeness

Projective exterior norm and bounded det.id: Projective exterior norm and bounded determinant embedding
Projective exterior norm and bounded det.description: For k≥1 on Λ=Λ^k_{K₁}E₁ define ‖ω‖π as the infimum of ∑_j∏_i‖x_{j,i}‖ over all finite wedge decompositions ω=∑_j x_{j,1}∧⋯∧x_{j,k}. This is a genuine K₁-norm, each pure wedge has norm at most the product of its factor norms, and its determinant array belongs to ℓ∞(ℕ^k,K₁) with ‖Ωω‖∞≤‖ω‖π. The determinant embedding is injective.
